before.quality:
static func quality(id: String, index: Dictionary = {}, stats_version: String = "") -> Dictionary:
	ensure()
	var source: Dictionary = index.get("qualities", {}) if not index.is_empty() else _qualities
	var found: Variant = source.get(id, {})
	if not found is Dictionary or found.is_empty(): return {}
	if stats_version.is_empty(): return found
	var tables: Dictionary = index.get("tables", {}) if not index.is_empty() else CATALOG.data.tables
	if not tables.has("SeasonEquipmentRules"): return found # Explicit pre-C05 archive policy.
	if equipment_rules(stats_version, index).is_empty(): return {}
	for row in tables.get("SeasonEquipment", []):
		if str(row.get("quality_id", "")).to_lower() != id.to_lower() or str(row.get("stats_version", "")) != stats_version: continue
		var resolved: Dictionary = found.duplicate(true)
		resolved["damage_percent"] = float(row.damage_base)
		resolved["resistance_percent"] = float(row.resist_base)
		resolved["damage_per_level"] = float(row.damage_per_level)
		resolved["resistance_per_level"] = float(row.resist_per_level)
		resolved["draw_interval_percent"] = -float(row.speed_base)
		resolved["draw_interval_per_level"] = -float(row.speed_per_level)
		resolved["stats_version"] = stats_version
		return resolved
	return {}

after.reward_refresh_gold:
static func reward_refresh_gold(refresh_index: int, index: Dictionary = {}) -> int:
	if refresh_index < 1 or refresh_index > 3: return -1
	var tables: Dictionary = index.get("tables", {}) if not index.is_empty() else CATALOG.data.tables
	var price := -1
	for row in tables.get("LootRules", []):
		if not row is Dictionary or row.get("refresh_index") != refresh_index: continue
		if price != -1: return -1
		var value: Variant = row.get("refresh_gold")
		if typeof(value) not in [TYPE_INT, TYPE_FLOAT]: return -1
		if not is_finite(float(value)) or float(value) != floor(float(value)) or float(value) <= 0 or float(value) > 2147483647: return -1
		price = int(value)
	return price

before.reconnect:
func reconnect() -> void:
	if busy: return
	# A WebSocket reconnect only works while its in-memory access token is still
	# valid. After restarting the client, restore a local development session
	# from the remembered account; cloud and Steam sessions must be re-authenticated.
	if gateway.token.is_empty() or gateway.session_expired():
		var is_local_server: bool = gateway.base_url.trim_suffix("/") == Gateway.DEFAULT_LOCAL_BASE_URL
		if OS.is_debug_build() and is_local_server and not gateway.local_account_name.is_empty():
			await _login(gateway.base_url, gateway.local_account_name, false)
		else:
			gateway.end_session(P.localized("login_session_invalid"))
		return
	busy = true
	connection = P.localized("restoring_connection")
	changed.emit()
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	await refresh_lobby()
	if generation == gateway.session_generation and not lobby.is_empty() and configuration_error.is_empty():
		gateway.connect_realtime()
	busy = false
	changed.emit()

before._ensure_room_catalog:
func _ensure_room_catalog(version: String) -> bool:
	if version == str(CATALOG.data.version): return true
	if version.is_empty() or version.length() > 80: return false
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	var address: String = gateway.base_url
	if _room_catalogs.has(version) and _room_catalogs[version].get("_origin", "") == address: return true
	var response: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/config/" + version.uri_encode(), HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, null, [404])
	if generation != gateway.session_generation or address != gateway.base_url: return false
	if not response.ok or not response.data is Dictionary: return false
	var envelope: Dictionary = response.data
	if str(envelope.get("configVersion", "")) != version or not envelope.get("bundle") is PackedByteArray: return false
	var reader := ConfigBundle.new()
	var decoded: Dictionary = reader.decode(envelope.bundle, version, str(envelope.get("contentHash", "")))
	if decoded.is_empty(): return false
	var index: Dictionary = CatalogIndex.from_data(decoded)
	if index.is_empty(): return false
	index["_origin"] = address
	_room_catalogs[version] = index
	return true

before.prepare:
func prepare(tier: String, potion_count: int) -> void:
	var borrowed: bool = season_preparation_active() and use_borrowed_deck
	if busy or (deck().is_empty() and not borrowed) or not configuration_error.is_empty(): return
	busy = true
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	var current_info: bool = not server_info.is_empty() and _server_info_address == gateway.base_url
	if not ((current_info and validate_config(str(server_info.get("configVersion", "")), "server")) or await _refresh_server_info()):
		if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
		busy = false
		changed.emit()
		return
	var safe: Array = []
	if tier == "Advanced": safe = [27]
	if tier == "Top": safe = [33, 34, 35]
	var payload := {"heroClass": hero_class, "deckVersion": 0 if borrowed else deck().version,
		"equipmentIds": loadout().get("equipmentIds", [null, null, null, null, null]),
		"backpackTier": tier, "safeSlotIndexes": safe, "potionCount": potion_count, "difficulty": "Standard"}
	if season_preparation_active():
		preparation_difficulty = clampi(preparation_difficulty, 0, season_preparation_cap())
		payload["difficulty"] = "D%d" % preparation_difficulty
		payload["seasonId"] = str(lobby.season.seasonId)
		if borrowed: payload["useBorrowedDeck"] = true
		var preference := season_loot_preference()
		if not preference.is_empty(): payload["lootPreferenceElement"] = preference
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/preparations", HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if result.ok and _preparation_config_valid(result.data):
		preparation = result.data
		lobby["activePreparation"] = result.data
		refresh_cache("inventory")
	busy = false
	changed.emit()
before.enqueue:
func enqueue() -> void:
	if busy or preparation.is_empty() or not gateway.online or not configuration_error.is_empty(): return
	busy = true
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	var current_info: bool = not server_info.is_empty() and _server_info_address == gateway.base_url
	if not ((current_info and validate_config(str(server_info.get("configVersion", "")), "server")) or await _refresh_server_info()) or not _preparation_config_valid(preparation):
		if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
		busy = false
		changed.emit()
		return
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/matches/enqueue", HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, {"preparationId": preparation.preparationId})
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if result.ok: ticket = result.data
	if result.ok: _verify_ready_ticket()
	busy = false
	changed.emit()

before._accept_combat_preview:
func _accept_combat_preview(payload: Dictionary) -> void:
	if payload.get("_replayed", false): return
	if not allowed("battle.play_cards") or not target_alive(combat_target_id()): return
	if _preview_request.is_empty() or payload.get("_request_id", "") != _preview_request.get("request_id", ""): return
	if Time.get_ticks_msec() >= _preview_deadline or _preview_request.get("context", {}) != _preview_context(selected_cards): return
	var revision := int(payload.get("_room_revision", -1))
	if revision != int(_preview_request.get("revision", -1)) or revision != int(room.get("room_revision", 0)): return
	var context: Dictionary = _preview_request.context
	if payload.has("battle_id") and payload.battle_id != context.battle_id: return
	if payload.has("target_id") and payload.target_id != context.target_id: return
	if payload.has("card_instance_ids") and payload.card_instance_ids != context.card_instance_ids: return
	var auxiliary := _preview_recovery_auxiliary(_calculate_combat_preview(selected_cards), payload)
	combat_preview = payload.duplicate(true)
	for field in ["heal_overflow", "shield_overflow"]:
		if auxiliary.get(field + "_source", "") == "unavailable": combat_preview.erase(field)
	combat_preview.merge(auxiliary, true)
	combat_preview["source_revision"] = revision
	combat_preview["authoritative"] = true
	combat_preview["control_estimated"] = false
	_preview_request = {}
	_preview_deadline = 0

before._load_settlement:
func _load_settlement(id: String) -> void:
	if settlement.get("settlementId", "") == id or _settlement_loading == id or _settlement_ack_pending_id == id: return
	var expected_match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if expected_match_id.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_loading = id
	_settlement_load_epoch += 1
	var load_epoch := _settlement_load_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Give a normal detail read one polling interval before automatic recovery.
	# A stalled detail must not block the same-match committed-receipt projection.
	_settlement_poll_at = maxi(_settlement_poll_at, Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500)
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/settlements/" + id)
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if load_epoch != _settlement_load_epoch: return
	if not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, expected_match_id):
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if _settlement_ack_pending_id == id:
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if result.ok and result.data is Dictionary and str(result.data.get("matchId", "")) == expected_match_id and str(result.data.get("settlementId", "")) == id:
		settlement = result.data
	_settlement_loading = ""
	changed.emit()
before._poll_ready_settlement:
func _poll_ready_settlement() -> void:
	if _settlement_polling or not settlement.is_empty() or not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty(): return
	var match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if match_id.is_empty() or gateway == null or gateway.token.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_polling = true
	_settlement_poll_request_epoch += 1
	var poll_epoch := _settlement_poll_request_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	_settlement_poll_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Bootstrap exposes only settlements whose asset holds have finished committing.
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/bootstrap?settlementMatchId=" + match_id.uri_encode(), HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, null, [0, 502, 503, 504])
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if poll_epoch != _settlement_poll_request_epoch: return
	_settlement_polling = false
	if not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty() or not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, match_id) or not settlement.is_empty(): return
	if not result.ok or not result.data is Dictionary:
		settlement_query_failed = true
		changed.emit()
		return
	var was_failed := settlement_query_failed
	settlement_query_failed = false
	var ready: Variant = result.data.get("unfinishedSettlement")
	if ready is Dictionary and str(ready.get("matchId", "")) == match_id:
		settlement = ready
		_settlement_recovery_match_id = ""
		changed.emit()
	elif was_failed:
		changed.emit()

after._accept_combat_preview:
func _accept_combat_preview(payload: Dictionary) -> void:
	if payload.get("_replayed", false): return
	if not allowed("battle.play_cards") or not target_alive(combat_target_id()): return
	if _preview_request.is_empty() or payload.get("_request_id", "") != _preview_request.get("request_id", ""): return
	if Time.get_ticks_msec() >= _preview_deadline or _preview_request.get("context", {}) != _preview_context(selected_cards): return
	var revision := int(payload.get("_room_revision", -1))
	if revision != int(_preview_request.get("revision", -1)) or revision != int(room.get("room_revision", 0)): return
	var context: Dictionary = _preview_request.context
	if payload.has("battle_id") and payload.battle_id != context.battle_id: return
	if payload.has("target_id") and payload.target_id != context.target_id: return
	if payload.has("card_instance_ids") and payload.card_instance_ids != context.card_instance_ids: return
	var auxiliary := _preview_recovery_auxiliary(_calculate_combat_preview(selected_cards), payload)
	combat_preview = payload.duplicate(true)
	for field in ["heal_overflow", "shield_overflow"]:
		if auxiliary.get(field + "_source", "") == "unavailable": combat_preview.erase(field)
	combat_preview.merge(auxiliary, true)
	combat_preview["source_revision"] = revision
	combat_preview["authoritative"] = true
	combat_preview["control_estimated"] = false
	_preview_request = {}
	_preview_deadline = 0

after._load_settlement:
func _load_settlement(id: String) -> void:
	if settlement.get("settlementId", "") == id or _settlement_loading == id or _settlement_ack_pending_id == id: return
	var expected_match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if expected_match_id.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_loading = id
	_settlement_load_epoch += 1
	var load_epoch := _settlement_load_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Give a normal detail read one polling interval before automatic recovery.
	# A stalled detail must not block the same-match committed-receipt projection.
	_settlement_poll_at = maxi(_settlement_poll_at, Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500)
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/settlements/" + id)
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if load_epoch != _settlement_load_epoch: return
	if not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, expected_match_id):
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if _settlement_ack_pending_id == id:
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if result.ok and result.data is Dictionary and str(result.data.get("matchId", "")) == expected_match_id and str(result.data.get("settlementId", "")) == id:
		settlement = result.data
	_settlement_loading = ""
	changed.emit()
after._poll_ready_settlement:
func _poll_ready_settlement() -> void:
	if _settlement_polling or not settlement.is_empty() or not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty(): return
	var match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if match_id.is_empty() or gateway == null or gateway.token.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_polling = true
	_settlement_poll_request_epoch += 1
	var poll_epoch := _settlement_poll_request_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	_settlement_poll_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Bootstrap exposes only settlements whose asset holds have finished committing.
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/bootstrap?settlementMatchId=" + match_id.uri_encode(), HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, null, [0, 502, 503, 504])
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if poll_epoch != _settlement_poll_request_epoch: return
	_settlement_polling = false
	if not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty() or not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, match_id) or not settlement.is_empty(): return
	if not result.ok or not result.data is Dictionary:
		settlement_query_failed = true
		changed.emit()
		return
	var was_failed := settlement_query_failed
	settlement_query_failed = false
	var ready: Variant = result.data.get("unfinishedSettlement")
	if ready is Dictionary and str(ready.get("matchId", "")) == match_id:
		settlement = ready
		_settlement_recovery_match_id = ""
		changed.emit()
	elif was_failed:
		changed.emit()

before._auto_card_score:
static func _auto_card_score(info: Dictionary, owned: Dictionary, preference: Dictionary, weapon_level: int, element_counts: Dictionary, class_count: int, selected_count: int) -> float:
	var quality_score := {"White": 0.0, "Green": 8.0, "Blue": 16.0, "Purple": 27.0, "Orange": 40.0}
	var score: float = quality_score.get(str(info.get("quality", "White")), 0.0)
	score += minf(8.0, float(int(owned.get("level", 0))) * 1.5)
	score += minf(4.0, float(int(owned.get("copyCount", 0))) * 0.5)
	var element := str(info.get("element", "None"))
	if preference.has(element): score += float(preference[element])
	var is_class := info.get("hero_class") != null
	if is_class:
		# High weapon levels make the class engine the primary reason to select a
		# class card. At ordinary levels, only cards that fit the current deck get
		# this extra weight, so a good general card can still win the slot.
		score += _class_synergy_score(info, Game.hero_class)
		if weapon_level >= 3: score += 12.0 + float(weapon_level - 2) * 5.0
		else: score += float(weapon_level) * 1.5
	else:
		score += _class_synergy_score(info, Game.hero_class)
	if element != "None" and not element.is_empty():
		var same := int(element_counts.get(element, 0))
		score += minf(12.0, float(same) * (2.5 if int(info.get("same_element_bonus", 0)) > 0 else 1.0))
	if int(info.get("resonance_bonus", 0)) > 0: score += 4.0 + float(element_counts.get(element, 0)) * 1.5
	if int(info.get("immediate_draw", 0)) > 0 or float(info.get("draw_charge", 0)) > 0.0: score += 3.0
	if float(info.get("stun_seconds", 0)) > 0.0: score += 2.5
	if int(info.get("heal", 0)) > 0: score += 2.0 if Game.hero_class == "Priest" else 0.5
	if int(info.get("shield", 0)) > 0: score += 2.0 if Game.hero_class == "Guardian" else 0.5
	# Reserve the early slots for the class engine when enough class cards exist.
	if selected_count < 7 and is_class: score += 14.0
	if selected_count >= 13 and not is_class and class_count < 7: score -= 18.0
	return score

before._float_number:
func _float_number(node: Control, value: String, tint: Color, index: int) -> void:
	var number := _label(self, value, 42, tint)
	number.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font("number"))
	number.name = "CombatNumber"
	number.set_meta("combat_float", true)
	number.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	number.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var actor_to_ui := get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * node.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
	var ui_scale := maxf(0.1, minf(absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().x), absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().y)))
	var base_scale := Vector2.ONE * ui_scale
	var text_width := P.font("number").get_string_size(value, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 42).x
	number.size = Vector2(maxf(170.0, text_width + 16.0), 54)
	number.scale = base_scale
	var top: Vector2 = actor_to_ui * Vector2(node.size.x * 0.5, 0)
	var travel := 72.0 * ui_scale
	var margin := 12.0 * ui_scale
	var peak_size := number.size * ui_scale * 1.08
	var position := top + Vector2(-number.size.x * ui_scale * 0.5 + index * 32.0 * ui_scale, (maxf(98.0, node.size.y * 0.25) + index * 26.0) * ui_scale)
	position.x = clampf(position.x, margin, maxf(margin, size.x - peak_size.x - margin))
	position.y = clampf(position.y, travel + margin, maxf(travel + margin, size.y - peak_size.y - margin))
	number.position = position
	number.set_meta("combat_float_travel", travel)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_ui_scale", ui_scale)
	number.z_index = 20
	number.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var tween := number.create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(number, "position:y", position.y - travel, 0.78).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale * 1.08, 0.1)
	tween.chain().tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale, 0.12)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(number, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.78)
	tween.chain().tween_callback(number.queue_free)

func _float_number(node: Control, value: String, tint: Color, index: int) -> void:

	number.name = "CombatNumber"
	number.set_meta("combat_float", true)
	number.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	number.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var actor_to_ui := get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * node.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
	var ui_scale := maxf(0.1, minf(absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().x), absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().y)))
	var base_scale := Vector2.ONE * ui_scale
	var text_width := P.font("number").get_string_size(value, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 42).x
	number.size = Vector2(maxf(170.0, text_width + 16.0), 54)
	number.scale = base_scale
	var top: Vector2 = actor_to_ui * Vector2(node.size.x * 0.5, 0)
	var travel := 72.0 * ui_scale
	var margin := 12.0 * ui_scale
	var peak_size := number.size * ui_scale * 1.08
	var position := top + Vector2(-number.size.x * ui_scale * 0.5 + index * 32.0 * ui_scale, (maxf(98.0, node.size.y * 0.25) + index * 26.0) * ui_scale)
	position.x = clampf(position.x, margin, maxf(margin, size.x - peak_size.x - margin))
	position.y = clampf(position.y, travel + margin, maxf(travel + margin, size.y - peak_size.y - margin))
	number.position = position
	number.set_meta("combat_float_travel", travel)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_ui_scale", ui_scale)
	number.z_index = 20
	number.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var tween := number.create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(number, "position:y", position.y - travel, 0.78).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale * 1.08, 0.1)
	tween.chain().tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale, 0.12)

before.reconnect:
func reconnect() -> void:
	if busy: return
	# A WebSocket reconnect only works while its in-memory access token is still
	# valid. After restarting the client, restore a local development session
	# from the remembered account; cloud and Steam sessions must be re-authenticated.
	if gateway.token.is_empty() or gateway.session_expired():
		var is_local_server: bool = gateway.base_url.trim_suffix("/") == Gateway.DEFAULT_LOCAL_BASE_URL
		if OS.is_debug_build() and is_local_server and not gateway.local_account_name.is_empty():
			await _login(gateway.base_url, gateway.local_account_name, false)
		else:
			gateway.end_session(P.localized("login_session_invalid"))
		return
	busy = true
	connection = P.localized("restoring_connection")
	changed.emit()
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	await refresh_lobby()
	if generation == gateway.session_generation and not lobby.is_empty() and configuration_error.is_empty():
		gateway.connect_realtime()
	busy = false
	changed.emit()

func _accept_combat_preview(payload: Dictionary) -> void:
	if payload.get("_replayed", false): return
	if not allowed("battle.play_cards") or not target_alive(combat_target_id()): return
	if _preview_request.is_empty() or payload.get("_request_id", "") != _preview_request.get("request_id", ""): return
	if Time.get_ticks_msec() >= _preview_deadline or _preview_request.get("context", {}) != _preview_context(selected_cards): return
	var revision := int(payload.get("_room_revision", -1))
	if revision != int(_preview_request.get("revision", -1)) or revision != int(room.get("room_revision", 0)): return
	var context: Dictionary = _preview_request.context
	if payload.has("battle_id") and payload.battle_id != context.battle_id: return
	if payload.has("target_id") and payload.target_id != context.target_id: return
	if payload.has("card_instance_ids") and payload.card_instance_ids != context.card_instance_ids: return
	var auxiliary := _preview_recovery_auxiliary(_calculate_combat_preview(selected_cards), payload)
	combat_preview = payload.duplicate(true)
	for field in ["heal_overflow", "shield_overflow"]:
		if auxiliary.get(field + "_source", "") == "unavailable": combat_preview.erase(field)
	combat_preview.merge(auxiliary, true)
	combat_preview["source_revision"] = revision
	combat_preview["authoritative"] = true
	combat_preview["control_estimated"] = false
	_preview_request = {}
	_preview_deadline = 0

func _load_settlement(id: String) -> void:
	if settlement.get("settlementId", "") == id or _settlement_loading == id or _settlement_ack_pending_id == id: return
	var expected_match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if expected_match_id.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_loading = id
	_settlement_load_epoch += 1
	var load_epoch := _settlement_load_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Give a normal detail read one polling interval before automatic recovery.
	# A stalled detail must not block the same-match committed-receipt projection.
	_settlement_poll_at = maxi(_settlement_poll_at, Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500)
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/settlements/" + id)
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if load_epoch != _settlement_load_epoch: return
	if not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, expected_match_id):
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if _settlement_ack_pending_id == id:
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if result.ok and result.data is Dictionary and str(result.data.get("matchId", "")) == expected_match_id and str(result.data.get("settlementId", "")) == id:
		settlement = result.data
	_settlement_loading = ""
	changed.emit()
before._poll_ready_settlement:
func _poll_ready_settlement() -> void:
	if _settlement_polling or not settlement.is_empty() or not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty(): return
	var match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if match_id.is_empty() or gateway == null or gateway.token.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_polling = true
	_settlement_poll_request_epoch += 1
	var poll_epoch := _settlement_poll_request_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	_settlement_poll_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Bootstrap exposes only settlements whose asset holds have finished committing.
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/bootstrap?settlementMatchId=" + match_id.uri_encode(), HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, null, [0, 502, 503, 504])
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if poll_epoch != _settlement_poll_request_epoch: return
	_settlement_polling = false
	if not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty() or not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, match_id) or not settlement.is_empty(): return
	if not result.ok or not result.data is Dictionary:
		settlement_query_failed = true
		changed.emit()
		return
	var was_failed := settlement_query_failed
	settlement_query_failed = false
	var ready: Variant = result.data.get("unfinishedSettlement")
	if ready is Dictionary and str(ready.get("matchId", "")) == match_id:
		settlement = ready
		_settlement_recovery_match_id = ""
		changed.emit()
	elif was_failed:
		changed.emit()

func _accept_combat_preview(payload: Dictionary) -> void:
	if payload.get("_replayed", false): return
	if not allowed("battle.play_cards") or not target_alive(combat_target_id()): return
	if _preview_request.is_empty() or payload.get("_request_id", "") != _preview_request.get("request_id", ""): return
	if Time.get_ticks_msec() >= _preview_deadline or _preview_request.get("context", {}) != _preview_context(selected_cards): return
	var revision := int(payload.get("_room_revision", -1))
	if revision != int(_preview_request.get("revision", -1)) or revision != int(room.get("room_revision", 0)): return
	var context: Dictionary = _preview_request.context
	if payload.has("battle_id") and payload.battle_id != context.battle_id: return
	if payload.has("target_id") and payload.target_id != context.target_id: return
	if payload.has("card_instance_ids") and payload.card_instance_ids != context.card_instance_ids: return
	var auxiliary := _preview_recovery_auxiliary(_calculate_combat_preview(selected_cards), payload)
	combat_preview = payload.duplicate(true)
	for field in ["heal_overflow", "shield_overflow"]:
		if auxiliary.get(field + "_source", "") == "unavailable": combat_preview.erase(field)
	combat_preview.merge(auxiliary, true)
	combat_preview["source_revision"] = revision
	combat_preview["authoritative"] = true
	combat_preview["control_estimated"] = false
	_preview_request = {}
	_preview_deadline = 0

after._load_settlement:
func _load_settlement(id: String) -> void:
	if settlement.get("settlementId", "") == id or _settlement_loading == id or _settlement_ack_pending_id == id: return
	var expected_match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if expected_match_id.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_loading = id
	_settlement_load_epoch += 1
	var load_epoch := _settlement_load_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Give a normal detail read one polling interval before automatic recovery.
	# A stalled detail must not block the same-match committed-receipt projection.
	_settlement_poll_at = maxi(_settlement_poll_at, Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500)
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/settlements/" + id)
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if load_epoch != _settlement_load_epoch: return
	if not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, expected_match_id):
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if _settlement_ack_pending_id == id:
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if result.ok and result.data is Dictionary and str(result.data.get("matchId", "")) == expected_match_id and str(result.data.get("settlementId", "")) == id:
		settlement = result.data
	_settlement_loading = ""
	changed.emit()
after._poll_ready_settlement:
func _poll_ready_settlement() -> void:
	if _settlement_polling or not settlement.is_empty() or not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty(): return
	var match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if match_id.is_empty() or gateway == null or gateway.token.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_polling = true
	_settlement_poll_request_epoch += 1
	var poll_epoch := _settlement_poll_request_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	_settlement_poll_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Bootstrap exposes only settlements whose asset holds have finished committing.
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/bootstrap?settlementMatchId=" + match_id.uri_encode(), HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, null, [0, 502, 503, 504])
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if poll_epoch != _settlement_poll_request_epoch: return
	_settlement_polling = false
	if not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty() or not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, match_id) or not settlement.is_empty(): return
	if not result.ok or not result.data is Dictionary:
		settlement_query_failed = true
		changed.emit()
		return
	var was_failed := settlement_query_failed
	settlement_query_failed = false
	var ready: Variant = result.data.get("unfinishedSettlement")
	if ready is Dictionary and str(ready.get("matchId", "")) == match_id:
		settlement = ready
		_settlement_recovery_match_id = ""
		changed.emit()
	elif was_failed:
		changed.emit()

	var scale: Vector2 = base.scale

	number.name = "CombatNumber"
	number.set_meta("combat_float", true)

	number.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var actor_to_ui := get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * node.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
	var ui_scale := maxf(0.1, minf(absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().x), absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().y)))
	var base_scale := Vector2.ONE * ui_scale
	var text_width := P.font("number").get_string_size(value, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 42).x
	number.size = Vector2(maxf(170.0, text_width + 16.0), 54)

	var margin := 12.0 * ui_scale

func _label(parent: Node, text: String, size: int = 24, color: Color = P.PAPER, localize: bool = true) -> Label:
	var node := Label.new()
	var display_text := P.localized_text(text) if localize else text
	var typeface := P.font_for_text(display_text, size)
	node.add_theme_font_override("font", typeface)
	node.text = display_text
	node.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
	node.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	node.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	# Container-managed labels need their shaped text height for layout. Fixed
	# overlay labels still clip to their authored rectangles.
	node.clip_text = not parent is Container
	parent.add_child(node)
	P.fit_control_font(node, typeface, size)
	return node

func _float_number(node: Control, value: String, tint: Color, index: int) -> void:
	var number := _label(self, value, 42, tint)
	number.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font("number"))
	number.name = "CombatNumber"
	number.set_meta("combat_float", true)
	number.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	number.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var actor_to_ui := get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * node.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
	var ui_scale := maxf(0.1, minf(absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().x), absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().y)))
	var base_scale := Vector2.ONE * ui_scale
	var text_width := P.font("number").get_string_size(value, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 42).x
	number.size = Vector2(maxf(170.0, text_width + 16.0), 54)
	number.scale = base_scale
	var top: Vector2 = actor_to_ui * Vector2(node.size.x * 0.5, 0)
	var travel := 72.0 * ui_scale
	var margin := 12.0 * ui_scale
	var peak_size := number.size * ui_scale * 1.08
	var position := top + Vector2(-number.size.x * ui_scale * 0.5 + index * 32.0 * ui_scale, (maxf(98.0, node.size.y * 0.25) + index * 26.0) * ui_scale)
	position.x = clampf(position.x, margin, maxf(margin, size.x - peak_size.x - margin))
	position.y = clampf(position.y, travel + margin, maxf(travel + margin, size.y - peak_size.y - margin))
	number.position = position
	number.set_meta("combat_float_travel", travel)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_ui_scale", ui_scale)
	number.z_index = 20
	number.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var tween := number.create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(number, "position:y", position.y - travel, 0.78).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale * 1.08, 0.1)
	tween.chain().tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale, 0.12)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(number, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.78)
	tween.chain().tween_callback(number.queue_free)

func _build_mail_rows(column: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	for child in column.get_children():
		column.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	for raw_item in Game.mail.get("items", []):
		var item: Dictionary = raw_item if raw_item is Dictionary else {}
		var id := str(item.get("id", item.get("mailId", "")))
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.name = "MailRow_" + id
		# The scrolling column sizes itself from its children. Reserve the viewport
		# width here so the preview area is not collapsed by the action buttons.
		row.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(760, 112)
		column.add_child(row)
		var title := RemoteCopy.field(item, "title")
		if title.is_empty(): title = P.localized("system_mail")
		var unread := not bool(item.get("read", item.get("isRead", false)))
		var attachments: Array = item.get("attachments", []) if item.get("attachments", []) is Array else []
		var preview := RemoteCopy.field(item, "body").replace("\n", " ")
		if preview.length() > 54: preview = preview.substr(0, 54) + "…"

before.reconnect:
func reconnect() -> void:
	if busy: return
	# A WebSocket reconnect only works while its in-memory access token is still
	# valid. After restarting the client, restore a local development session
	# from the remembered account; cloud and Steam sessions must be re-authenticated.
	if gateway.token.is_empty() or gateway.session_expired():
		var is_local_server: bool = gateway.base_url.trim_suffix("/") == Gateway.DEFAULT_LOCAL_BASE_URL
		if OS.is_debug_build() and is_local_server and not gateway.local_account_name.is_empty():
			await _login(gateway.base_url, gateway.local_account_name, false)
		else:
			gateway.end_session(P.localized("login_session_invalid"))
		return
	busy = true
	connection = P.localized("restoring_connection")
	changed.emit()
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	await refresh_lobby()
	if generation == gateway.session_generation and not lobby.is_empty() and configuration_error.is_empty():
		gateway.connect_realtime()
	busy = false
	changed.emit()

	if _preview_request.is_empty() or payload.get("_request_id", "") != _preview_request.get("request_id", ""): return

	var revision := int(payload.get("_room_revision", -1))

	if payload.has("battle_id") and payload.battle_id != context.battle_id: return

	if settlement.get("settlementId", "") == id or _settlement_loading == id or _settlement_ack_pending_id == id: return
	var expected_match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if expected_match_id.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_loading = id
	_settlement_load_epoch += 1
	var load_epoch := _settlement_load_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Give a normal detail read one polling interval before automatic recovery.
	# A stalled detail must not block the same-match committed-receipt projection.
	_settlement_poll_at = maxi(_settlement_poll_at, Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500)
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/settlements/" + id)
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if load_epoch != _settlement_load_epoch: return
	if not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, expected_match_id):
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if _settlement_ack_pending_id == id:
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if result.ok and result.data is Dictionary and str(result.data.get("matchId", "")) == expected_match_id and str(result.data.get("settlementId", "")) == id:
		settlement = result.data
	_settlement_loading = ""
	changed.emit()

	if _settlement_polling or not settlement.is_empty() or not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty(): return

	_settlement_poll_request_epoch += 1
	var poll_epoch := _settlement_poll_request_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	_settlement_poll_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Bootstrap exposes only settlements whose asset holds have finished committing.
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/bootstrap?settlementMatchId=" + match_id.uri_encode(), HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, null, [0, 502, 503, 504])
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if poll_epoch != _settlement_poll_request_epoch: return
	_settlement_polling = false
	if not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty() or not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, match_id) or not settlement.is_empty(): return
	if not result.ok or not result.data is Dictionary:
		settlement_query_failed = true
		changed.emit()
		return
	var was_failed := settlement_query_failed
	settlement_query_failed = false
	var ready: Variant = result.data.get("unfinishedSettlement")

	elif was_failed:

after.reconnect:
func reconnect() -> void:
	if busy: return
	# A WebSocket reconnect only works while its in-memory access token is still
	# valid. After restarting the client, restore a local development session
	# from the remembered account; cloud and Steam sessions must be re-authenticated.
	if gateway.token.is_empty() or gateway.session_expired():
		var is_local_server: bool = gateway.base_url.trim_suffix("/") == Gateway.DEFAULT_LOCAL_BASE_URL
		if OS.is_debug_build() and is_local_server and not gateway.local_account_name.is_empty():
			await _login(gateway.base_url, gateway.local_account_name, false)
		else:
			gateway.end_session(P.localized("login_session_invalid"))
		return
	busy = true
	connection = P.localized("restoring_connection")
	changed.emit()
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	await refresh_lobby()
	if generation == gateway.session_generation and not lobby.is_empty() and configuration_error.is_empty():
		gateway.connect_realtime()
	busy = false
	changed.emit()

before._label:
func _label(parent: Node, text: String, size: int = 24, color: Color = P.PAPER, localize: bool = true) -> Label:
	var node := Label.new()
	var display_text := P.localized_text(text) if localize else text
	var typeface := P.font_for_text(display_text, size)
	node.add_theme_font_override("font", typeface)
	node.text = display_text
	node.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
	node.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	node.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	# Container-managed labels need their shaped text height for layout. Fixed
	# overlay labels still clip to their authored rectangles.
	node.clip_text = not parent is Container
	parent.add_child(node)
	P.fit_control_font(node, typeface, size)
	return node
before._button:
func _button(parent: Node, text: String, callback: Callable, disabled: bool = false, key: String = "") -> Button:
	var button := Button.new()
	button.text = P.localized_text(text)
	button.disabled = disabled
	button.custom_minimum_size.y = 62
	button.clip_text = true
	button.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
	button.pressed.connect(callback)
	var button_key := key if not key.is_empty() else ("UI/CardCodex/card_codex_action_button_orange.png" if _is_positive_button(text) else "UI/CardCodex/card_codex_action_button_blue.png")
	Art.button(button, button_key)
	if parent is HBoxContainer:
		var caption_width := 0.0
		for line in button.text.split("\n"):
			caption_width = maxf(caption_width, button.get_theme_font("font").get_string_size(line, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 24).x)
		button.custom_minimum_size.x = clampf(ceilf(caption_width) + 48.0, 120.0, 420.0)
	parent.add_child(button)
	P.fit_control_font(button, button.get_theme_font("font"), 24, 48.0)
	return button

func _is_positive_button(value: String) -> bool:
	for keyword in [P.localized("confirm"), P.localized("claim"), P.localized("login"), P.localized("register"), "Login", P.localized("begin_action"), P.localized("save"), P.localized("buy"), P.localized("empower"), P.localized("equip"), P.localized("list_for_sale"), P.localized("select"), P.localized("ready"), P.localized("nav_prep"), P.localized("random_name"), "Randomize"]:
		if value.contains(keyword): return true
	return false

func _float_number(node: Control, value: String, tint: Color, index: int) -> void:
	var number := _label(self, value, 42, tint)
	number.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font("number"))
	number.name = "CombatNumber"
	number.set_meta("combat_float", true)
	number.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	number.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var actor_to_ui := get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * node.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
	var ui_scale := maxf(0.1, minf(absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().x), absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().y)))
	var base_scale := Vector2.ONE * ui_scale
	var text_width := P.font("number").get_string_size(value, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 42).x
	number.size = Vector2(maxf(170.0, text_width + 16.0), 54)
	number.scale = base_scale
	var top: Vector2 = actor_to_ui * Vector2(node.size.x * 0.5, 0)
	var travel := 72.0 * ui_scale
	var margin := 12.0 * ui_scale
	var peak_size := number.size * ui_scale * 1.08
	var position := top + Vector2(-number.size.x * ui_scale * 0.5 + index * 32.0 * ui_scale, (maxf(98.0, node.size.y * 0.25) + index * 26.0) * ui_scale)
	position.x = clampf(position.x, margin, maxf(margin, size.x - peak_size.x - margin))
	position.y = clampf(position.y, travel + margin, maxf(travel + margin, size.y - peak_size.y - margin))
	number.position = position
	number.set_meta("combat_float_travel", travel)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_ui_scale", ui_scale)
	number.z_index = 20
	number.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var tween := number.create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(number, "position:y", position.y - travel, 0.78).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale * 1.08, 0.1)
	tween.chain().tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale, 0.12)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(number, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.78)
	tween.chain().tween_callback(number.queue_free)

func _label(parent: Node, text: String, size: int = 24, color: Color = P.PAPER, localize: bool = true) -> Label:
	var node := Label.new()
	var display_text := P.localized_text(text) if localize else text
	var typeface := P.font_for_text(display_text, size)
	node.add_theme_font_override("font", typeface)
	node.text = display_text
	node.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
	node.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	node.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	# Container-managed labels need their shaped text height for layout. Fixed
	# overlay labels still clip to their authored rectangles.
	node.clip_text = not parent is Container
	parent.add_child(node)
	P.fit_control_font(node, typeface, size)
	return node
after._button:
func _button(parent: Node, text: String, callback: Callable, disabled: bool = false, key: String = "") -> Button:
	var button := Button.new()
	button.text = P.localized_text(text)
	button.disabled = disabled
	button.custom_minimum_size.y = 62
	button.clip_text = true
	button.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
	button.pressed.connect(callback)
	var button_key := key if not key.is_empty() else ("UI/CardCodex/card_codex_action_button_orange.png" if _is_positive_button(text) else "UI/CardCodex/card_codex_action_button_blue.png")
	Art.button(button, button_key)
	if parent is HBoxContainer:
		var caption_width := 0.0
		for line in button.text.split("\n"):
			caption_width = maxf(caption_width, button.get_theme_font("font").get_string_size(line, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 24).x)
		button.custom_minimum_size.x = clampf(ceilf(caption_width) + 48.0, 120.0, 420.0)
	parent.add_child(button)
	P.fit_control_font(button, button.get_theme_font("font"), 24, 48.0)
	return button

func _float_number(node: Control, value: String, tint: Color, index: int) -> void:
	var number := _label(self, value, 42, tint)
	number.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font("number"))
	number.name = "CombatNumber"
	number.set_meta("combat_float", true)
	number.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	number.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var actor_to_ui := get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * node.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
	var ui_scale := maxf(0.1, minf(absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().x), absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().y)))
	var base_scale := Vector2.ONE * ui_scale
	var text_width := P.font("number").get_string_size(value, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 42).x
	number.size = Vector2(maxf(170.0, text_width + 16.0), 54)
	number.scale = base_scale
	var top: Vector2 = actor_to_ui * Vector2(node.size.x * 0.5, 0)
	var travel := 72.0 * ui_scale
	var margin := 12.0 * ui_scale
	var peak_size := number.size * ui_scale * 1.08
	var position := top + Vector2(-number.size.x * ui_scale * 0.5 + index * 32.0 * ui_scale, (maxf(98.0, node.size.y * 0.25) + index * 26.0) * ui_scale)
	position.x = clampf(position.x, margin, maxf(margin, size.x - peak_size.x - margin))
	position.y = clampf(position.y, travel + margin, maxf(travel + margin, size.y - peak_size.y - margin))
	number.position = position
	number.set_meta("combat_float_travel", travel)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_ui_scale", ui_scale)
	number.z_index = 20
	number.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var tween := number.create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(number, "position:y", position.y - travel, 0.78).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale * 1.08, 0.1)
	tween.chain().tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale, 0.12)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(number, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.78)
	tween.chain().tween_callback(number.queue_free)

before.reconnect:
func reconnect() -> void:
	if busy: return
	# A WebSocket reconnect only works while its in-memory access token is still
	# valid. After restarting the client, restore a local development session
	# from the remembered account; cloud and Steam sessions must be re-authenticated.
	if gateway.token.is_empty() or gateway.session_expired():
		var is_local_server: bool = gateway.base_url.trim_suffix("/") == Gateway.DEFAULT_LOCAL_BASE_URL
		if OS.is_debug_build() and is_local_server and not gateway.local_account_name.is_empty():
			await _login(gateway.base_url, gateway.local_account_name, false)
		else:
			gateway.end_session(P.localized("login_session_invalid"))
		return
	busy = true
	connection = P.localized("restoring_connection")
	changed.emit()
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	await refresh_lobby()
	if generation == gateway.session_generation and not lobby.is_empty() and configuration_error.is_empty():
		gateway.connect_realtime()
	busy = false
	changed.emit()

before._accept_combat_preview:
func _accept_combat_preview(payload: Dictionary) -> void:
	if payload.get("_replayed", false): return
	if not allowed("battle.play_cards") or not target_alive(combat_target_id()): return
	if _preview_request.is_empty() or payload.get("_request_id", "") != _preview_request.get("request_id", ""): return
	if Time.get_ticks_msec() >= _preview_deadline or _preview_request.get("context", {}) != _preview_context(selected_cards): return
	var revision := int(payload.get("_room_revision", -1))
	if revision != int(_preview_request.get("revision", -1)) or revision != int(room.get("room_revision", 0)): return
	var context: Dictionary = _preview_request.context
	if payload.has("battle_id") and payload.battle_id != context.battle_id: return
	if payload.has("target_id") and payload.target_id != context.target_id: return
	if payload.has("card_instance_ids") and payload.card_instance_ids != context.card_instance_ids: return
	var auxiliary := _preview_recovery_auxiliary(_calculate_combat_preview(selected_cards), payload)
	combat_preview = payload.duplicate(true)
	for field in ["heal_overflow", "shield_overflow"]:
		if auxiliary.get(field + "_source", "") == "unavailable": combat_preview.erase(field)
	combat_preview.merge(auxiliary, true)
	combat_preview["source_revision"] = revision
	combat_preview["authoritative"] = true
	combat_preview["control_estimated"] = false
	_preview_request = {}
	_preview_deadline = 0

before._load_settlement:
func _load_settlement(id: String) -> void:
	if settlement.get("settlementId", "") == id or _settlement_loading == id or _settlement_ack_pending_id == id: return
	var expected_match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if expected_match_id.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_loading = id
	_settlement_load_epoch += 1
	var load_epoch := _settlement_load_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Give a normal detail read one polling interval before automatic recovery.
	# A stalled detail must not block the same-match committed-receipt projection.
	_settlement_poll_at = maxi(_settlement_poll_at, Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500)
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/settlements/" + id)
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if load_epoch != _settlement_load_epoch: return
	if not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, expected_match_id):
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if _settlement_ack_pending_id == id:
		_settlement_loading = ""
		return
	if result.ok and result.data is Dictionary and str(result.data.get("matchId", "")) == expected_match_id and str(result.data.get("settlementId", "")) == id:
		settlement = result.data
	_settlement_loading = ""
	changed.emit()
before._poll_ready_settlement:
func _poll_ready_settlement() -> void:
	if _settlement_polling or not settlement.is_empty() or not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty(): return
	var match_id := _settlement_match_id()
	if match_id.is_empty() or gateway == null or gateway.token.is_empty(): return
	_settlement_polling = true
	_settlement_poll_request_epoch += 1
	var poll_epoch := _settlement_poll_request_epoch
	var context_epoch := _room_context_epoch
	_settlement_poll_at = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 2500
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	# Bootstrap exposes only settlements whose asset holds have finished committing.
	var result: Dictionary = await gateway.request("/api/v1/bootstrap?settlementMatchId=" + match_id.uri_encode(), HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, null, [0, 502, 503, 504])
	if generation != gateway.session_generation: return
	if poll_epoch != _settlement_poll_request_epoch: return
	_settlement_polling = false
	if not _settlement_ack_pending_id.is_empty() or not _settlement_request_current(generation, context_epoch, match_id) or not settlement.is_empty(): return
	if not result.ok or not result.data is Dictionary:
		settlement_query_failed = true
		changed.emit()
		return
	var was_failed := settlement_query_failed
	settlement_query_failed = false
	var ready: Variant = result.data.get("unfinishedSettlement")
	if ready is Dictionary and str(ready.get("matchId", "")) == match_id:
		settlement = ready
		_settlement_recovery_match_id = ""
		changed.emit()
	elif was_failed:
		changed.emit()

after.reconnect:
func reconnect() -> void:
	if busy: return
	# A WebSocket reconnect only works while its in-memory access token is still
	# valid. After restarting the client, restore a local development session
	# from the remembered account; cloud and Steam sessions must be re-authenticated.
	if gateway.token.is_empty() or gateway.session_expired():
		var is_local_server: bool = gateway.base_url.trim_suffix("/") == Gateway.DEFAULT_LOCAL_BASE_URL
		if OS.is_debug_build() and is_local_server and not gateway.local_account_name.is_empty():
			await _login(gateway.base_url, gateway.local_account_name, false)
		else:
			gateway.end_session(P.localized("login_session_invalid"))
		return
	busy = true
	connection = P.localized("restoring_connection")
	changed.emit()
	var generation: int = gateway.session_generation
	await refresh_lobby()
	if generation == gateway.session_generation and not lobby.is_empty() and configuration_error.is_empty():
		gateway.connect_realtime()
	busy = false
	changed.emit()

	var values := bonuses(status)
	match status.get("passive_kind", ""):
		"FenXian": return P.localized("battle_passive_mage") % [P.word(status.get("core_element", "None")), status.get("combo", 0), status.get("charge_level", 0), Details.percent(values.get("weapon_bonus", 0))]
		"LinYuan": return P.localized("battle_passive_priest") % [Details.percent(values.get("passive_heal", 0)), Details.percent(values.get("passive_control", 0)), Details.percent(values.get("weapon_bonus", 0))]

			var text := P.localized("battle_passive_mage") % [P.word(status.get("core_element", "None")), status.get("combo", 0), status.get("charge_level", 0), Details.percent(values.get("weapon_bonus", 0))]
			if str(numerical.get("fenxian_policy", "")) == "SeasonRateBudgetedRhythm":
				text += "\n" + P.localized("battle_mage_return_budget") % [float(numerical.get("fenxian_return_credit", "0")), float(numerical.get("fenxian_return_rate_basis_points", 0)) / 100.0]

		"LinYuan": return P.localized("battle_passive_priest") % [Details.percent(values.get("passive_heal", 0)), Details.percent(values.get("passive_control", 0)), Details.percent(values.get("weapon_bonus", 0))]

before._ensure_nodes:
func _ensure_nodes() -> bool:
	if dialog_panel == null: dialog_panel = get_node_or_null("DialogPanel") as Panel
	if title_label == null: title_label = get_node_or_null("DialogPanel/Title") as Label
	if description_label == null: description_label = get_node_or_null("DialogPanel/Description") as Label
	if cancel_button == null: cancel_button = get_node_or_null("DialogPanel/CancelButton") as Button
	if confirm_button == null: confirm_button = get_node_or_null("DialogPanel/ConfirmButton") as Button
	return is_instance_valid(dialog_panel) and is_instance_valid(title_label) and is_instance_valid(description_label) and is_instance_valid(cancel_button) and is_instance_valid(confirm_button)
before._setup:
func _setup() -> void:
	if _wired or not _ensure_nodes(): return
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	z_index = 4096
	var backdrop := get_node_or_null("Backdrop") as Control
	if backdrop != null:
		backdrop.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		backdrop.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	if dialog_panel != null: dialog_panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	dialog_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", Art.style(PANEL))
	Art.button(confirm_button, CONFIRM_BUTTON)
	Art.button(cancel_button, CANCEL_BUTTON)
	confirm_button.set_meta("sound_cue", "ui_confirm")
	cancel_button.set_meta("sound_cue", "ui_cancel")
	title_label.text = P.localized("confirm_action")
	confirm_button.text = P.localized("confirm")
	cancel_button.text = P.localized("cancel")
	for label in [title_label, description_label]:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", P.PAPER)
		label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	title_label.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font("title"))
	description_label.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font("body"))
	for button in [cancel_button, confirm_button]:
		button.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font_for_text(button.text, 26))
		button.clip_text = true
		button.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
		P.fit_control_font(button, P.font_for_text(button.text, 26), 26, 48.0)
	cancel_button.pressed.connect(_cancel)
	confirm_button.pressed.connect(_accept)
	description_label.resized.connect(_fit_description)
	_fit_description.call_deferred()
	_wired = true
before.configure:
func configure(message: String, action: Callable, options: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	_setup()
	if not _ensure_nodes(): return
	_action = action
	title_label.text = _localized_display(str(options.get("title", "confirm_action")))
	description_label.text = _localized_display(message)
	confirm_button.text = _localized_display(str(options.get("confirm_text", "confirm")))
	cancel_button.text = _localized_display(str(options.get("cancel_text", "cancel")))
	var info_only := bool(options.get("info_only", false))
	var tall := bool(options.get("tall", false))
	cancel_button.visible = not info_only
	if info_only:
		# Keep the information dialog on the same shared modal/panel artwork,
		# but present one centered close action instead of a confirmation pair.
		confirm_button.position = Vector2(345, 326)
		confirm_button.size = Vector2(270, 74)

	node.add_theme_font_override("font", typeface)

	node.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
	node.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	node.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART

func _float_number(node: Control, value: String, tint: Color, index: int) -> void:
	var number := _label(self, value, 42, tint)
	number.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font("number"))
	number.name = "CombatNumber"
	number.set_meta("combat_float", true)
	number.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	number.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var actor_to_ui := get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * node.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
	var ui_scale := maxf(0.1, minf(absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().x), absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().y)))
	var base_scale := Vector2.ONE * ui_scale
	var text_width := P.font("number").get_string_size(value, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 42).x
	number.size = Vector2(maxf(170.0, text_width + 16.0), 54)
	number.scale = base_scale
	var top: Vector2 = actor_to_ui * Vector2(node.size.x * 0.5, 0)
	var travel := 72.0 * ui_scale
	var margin := 12.0 * ui_scale
	var peak_size := number.size * ui_scale * 1.08
	var position := top + Vector2(-number.size.x * ui_scale * 0.5 + index * 32.0 * ui_scale, (maxf(98.0, node.size.y * 0.25) + index * 26.0) * ui_scale)
	position.x = clampf(position.x, margin, maxf(margin, size.x - peak_size.x - margin))
	position.y = clampf(position.y, travel + margin, maxf(travel + margin, size.y - peak_size.y - margin))
	number.position = position
	number.set_meta("combat_float_travel", travel)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_ui_scale", ui_scale)
	number.z_index = 20
	number.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var tween := number.create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(number, "position:y", position.y - travel, 0.78).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale * 1.08, 0.1)
	tween.chain().tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale, 0.12)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(number, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.78)
	tween.chain().tween_callback(number.queue_free)

func _label(parent: Node, text: String, size: int = 24, color: Color = P.PAPER, localize: bool = true) -> Label:
	var node := Label.new()
	var display_text := P.localized_text(text) if localize else text
	var typeface := P.font_for_text(display_text, size)
	node.add_theme_font_override("font", typeface)
	node.text = display_text
	node.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
	node.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	node.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	# Container-managed labels need their shaped text height for layout. Fixed
	# overlay labels still clip to their authored rectangles.
	node.clip_text = not parent is Container
	parent.add_child(node)
	P.fit_control_font(node, typeface, size)
	return node

func _button(parent: Node, text: String, callback: Callable, disabled: bool = false, key: String = "") -> Button:

	button.disabled = disabled
	button.custom_minimum_size.y = 62
	button.clip_text = true
	button.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS

	Art.button(button, button_key)

			caption_width = maxf(caption_width, button.get_theme_font("font").get_string_size(line, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 24).x)
		button.custom_minimum_size.x = clampf(ceilf(caption_width) + 48.0, 120.0, 420.0)

func _restore_shop_scroll(scroll: ScrollContainer) -> void:
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(scroll) or screen != "shop" or not is_instance_valid(_reference): return
	if _reference.get_node_or_null("ShopScroll") != scroll: return
	scroll.scroll_horizontal = _shop_scroll
	scroll.get_h_scroll_bar().value_changed.connect(func(value: float):
		if is_instance_valid(_reference) and _reference.get_node_or_null("ShopScroll") == scroll:
			_shop_scroll = int(value))

after._claim:
func _claim(option: Dictionary, equip: bool = false) -> void:
	var player: Dictionary = Game.room.get("player", {})
	var items: Array = player.get("inventory", [])
	var origin := [Game.gateway.session_generation, Game._room_context_epoch, Game.room.get("match_id", ""), Game.room.get("room_id", "")]
	var still_current := func() -> bool:
		return origin == [Game.gateway.session_generation, Game._room_context_epoch, Game.room.get("match_id", ""), Game.room.get("room_id", "")] and Game.allowed("reward.choice.claim") and Game.room.get("reward_choice", {}).get("options", []).any(func(value): return value.get("option_id") == option.get("option_id"))
	var reward_item := {"kind": "Equipment" if int(option.kind) == 1 else "EquipmentFragments", "item_id": option.get("item_id", "")}
	var payload := {"option_id": option.option_id, "equip": equip}
	if not equip and int(option.kind) != 3 and not InventoryView.can_add(player, reward_item):
		var dialog := AcceptDialog.new()
		dialog.name = "RewardReplacementDialog"
		dialog.title = P.localized("bag_full_replace")
		var dialog_theme := P.theme().duplicate()
		dialog_theme.default_font_size = 24
		dialog_theme.set_stylebox("panel", "AcceptDialog", P.box(Color("10272e"), P.GOLD))
		var frame := P.box(Color("10272e"), P.GOLD)
		frame.set_expand_margin(SIDE_TOP, 36)
		frame.content_margin_top = 36
		dialog_theme.set_stylebox("embedded_border", "Window", frame)
		dialog_theme.set_stylebox("embedded_unfocused_border", "Window", frame.duplicate())
		dialog_theme.set_font("title_font", "Window", P.font("title"))
		dialog_theme.set_font_size("title_font_size", "Window", 24)
		dialog_theme.set_color("title_color", "Window", P.GOLD)
		dialog.theme = dialog_theme
		dialog.get_ok_button().text = P.localized("cancel")
		var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
		var available := get_viewport_rect().size
		var popup_size := Vector2i(mini(840, int(available.x) - 64), mini(560, int(available.y) - 64))
		scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(popup_size.x - 64, popup_size.y - 128)
		scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
		dialog.add_child(scroll)
		var column := VBoxContainer.new()
		column.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		scroll.add_child(column)
		for item in items:
			var button := _button(column, "", func():
				dialog.queue_free()
				if not still_current.call(): return
				_confirm(P.localized("recycle_for_loot") % EquipmentDetails.title(item), func():
					if not still_current.call(): return
					payload.replace_item_id = item.item_id
					Game.command("reward.choice.claim", payload)))
			button.name = "RewardReplacement_" + str(item.get("item_id", ""))
			var caption := Label.new()
			caption.text = "%s ×%s%s" % [EquipmentDetails.title(item), item.quantity, P.localized("safe_slot_suffix") if item.get("is_safe", false) else ""]
			caption.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
			caption.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
			caption.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
			caption.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
			caption.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font_for_text(caption.text, 24))
			caption.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
			button.add_child(caption)
			P.apply_text_direction(caption)
			var fit := func():
				caption.position = Vector2(20, 8)
				caption.size = Vector2(maxf(1, button.size.x - 40), maxf(1, button.size.y - 16))
				button.custom_minimum_size.y = maxf(72, caption.get_line_count() * caption.get_theme_font("font").get_height(24) + 16)
			button.resized.connect(fit)
			fit.call_deferred()
		add_child(dialog)
		dialog.confirmed.connect(dialog.queue_free)
		dialog.canceled.connect(dialog.queue_free)
		dialog.popup_centered(popup_size)
	elif equip:
		_confirm(P.localized("direct_equip_recycle"), func():
			if still_current.call(): Game.command("reward.choice.claim", payload))
	else: Game.command("reward.choice.claim", payload)

after._show_ban_dialog:
func _show_ban_dialog(reason: String) -> void:
	var ban := RemoteCopy.account_ban(reason)
	if ban.is_empty(): return
	var dialog := AcceptDialog.new()
	dialog.name = "AccountBanDialog"
	dialog.title = P.localized("ui_account_banned")
	dialog.theme = P.theme()
	dialog.get_ok_button().text = P.localized("confirm")
	dialog.dialog_text = P.localized("ui_account_banned")
	if not str(ban.reason).is_empty(): dialog.dialog_text += "\n" + str(ban.reason)
	dialog.confirmed.connect(dialog.queue_free)
	dialog.canceled.connect(dialog.queue_free)
	add_child(dialog)
	dialog.popup_centered(Vector2i(700, 360))
after._health_bar:
func _health_bar(parent: Node, combat: Dictionary) -> void:
	var bar := BoundedBar.new()
	bar.configure("UI/Encounter/encounter_hp_fill_normal.png", "UI/Encounter/encounter_hp_track_normal.png")
	bar.max_value = maxf(1, float(combat.get("effective_maximum_hp", combat.get("maximum_hp", 1))))
	bar.value = float(combat.get("hp", 0))
	bar.custom_minimum_size.y = 20
	parent.add_child(bar)
	if int(combat.get("shield", 0)) > 0:
		var shield := BoundedBar.new()
		shield.configure_solid(Color("102128"), Color("c4d2d4"))
		shield.max_value = bar.max_value
		shield.value = float(combat.shield)
		shield.custom_minimum_size.y = 8
		parent.add_child(shield)

after._hit_reaction:
func _hit_reaction(node: Control) -> void:
	var base := _reaction_base(node)
	var position: Vector2 = base.position
	var scale: Vector2 = base.scale
	var normal: Color = base.modulate
	var red := Color(1.0, 0.28, 0.24, normal.a)
	var tween := node.create_tween()
	node.set_meta("combat_reaction_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(node, "position", position + Vector2(0, -18), 0.08).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "scale", scale * 0.97, 0.08)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "modulate", red, 0.06)
	tween.tween_property(node, "position", position + Vector2(0, 7), 0.07).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "modulate", red.lightened(0.12), 0.07)
	tween.tween_property(node, "position", position + Vector2(0, -4), 0.06).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "scale", scale * 0.99, 0.06)
	tween.tween_property(node, "position", position, 0.13).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "scale", scale, 0.13)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "modulate", normal, 0.16)
after._attack_reaction:
func _attack_reaction(node: Control, target: Control) -> void:
	var base := _reaction_base(node)
	var position: Vector2 = base.position
	var scale: Vector2 = base.scale
	var direction := 1.0
	if is_instance_valid(target) and target.global_position.x < node.global_position.x: direction = -1.0
	var toward := Vector2(28.0 * direction, 0)
	var recoil := Vector2(-15.0 * direction, 0)
	var tween := node.create_tween()
	node.set_meta("combat_reaction_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(node, "position", position + toward, 0.11).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "scale", scale * 1.04, 0.11)
	tween.tween_property(node, "position", position + recoil, 0.07).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "scale", scale * 0.98, 0.07)
	tween.tween_property(node, "position", position + Vector2(7.0 * direction, 0), 0.06).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "scale", scale * 1.02, 0.06)
	tween.tween_property(node, "position", position, 0.14).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(node, "scale", scale, 0.14)
after._float_number:
func _float_number(node: Control, value: String, tint: Color, index: int) -> void:
	var number := _label(self, value, 42, tint)
	number.add_theme_font_override("font", P.font("number"))
	number.name = "CombatNumber"
	number.set_meta("combat_float", true)
	number.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	number.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var actor_to_ui := get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * node.get_global_transform_with_canvas()
	var ui_scale := maxf(0.1, minf(absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().x), absf(actor_to_ui.get_scale().y)))
	var base_scale := Vector2.ONE * ui_scale
	var text_width := P.font("number").get_string_size(value, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 42).x
	number.size = Vector2(maxf(170.0, text_width + 16.0), 54)
	number.scale = base_scale
	var top: Vector2 = actor_to_ui * Vector2(node.size.x * 0.5, 0)
	var travel := 72.0 * ui_scale
	var margin := 12.0 * ui_scale
	var peak_size := number.size * ui_scale * 1.08
	var position := top + Vector2(-number.size.x * ui_scale * 0.5 + index * 32.0 * ui_scale, (maxf(98.0, node.size.y * 0.25) + index * 26.0) * ui_scale)
	position.x = clampf(position.x, margin, maxf(margin, size.x - peak_size.x - margin))
	position.y = clampf(position.y, travel + margin, maxf(travel + margin, size.y - peak_size.y - margin))
	number.position = position
	number.set_meta("combat_float_travel", travel)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_ui_scale", ui_scale)
	number.z_index = 20
	number.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var tween := number.create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	number.set_meta("combat_float_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(number, "position:y", position.y - travel, 0.78).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale * 1.08, 0.1)
	tween.chain().tween_property(number, "scale", base_scale, 0.12)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(number, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.78)
	tween.chain().tween_callback(number.queue_free)
